questions.stem_text:
Which of the following best describes Dworkin's distinction between principles and
policies?

options.A: Principles are legislative, policies are precedents.
options.B: Principles describe rights, policies describe duties.
options.C: Principles are democratic, policies are autocratic.
options.D: Principles describe rights, policies describe goals.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Principles describe rights, policies describe goals.

questions.stem_text: Functions of the law include all but which of the following?

options.D: promoting the principles of the free enterprise system

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - promoting the principles of the free enterprise system

questions.stem_text: Is piracy under international (jure gentium) law subject to universal jurisdiction?

options.A: Piracy jure gentium is subject to flag State jurisdiction
options.B: Piracy jure gentium is subject to universal jurisdiction
options.C: Piracy jure gentium is subject to port State jurisdiction
options.D: Piracy jure gentium is subject to nationality-based jurisdiction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Piracy jure gentium is subject to universal jurisdiction

questions.stem_text: Which are the formal sources of international law?

options.B: Custom, general principles of law and theory
options.C: Treaties, custom and general principles of law
options.D: Treaties, custom and General Assembly Resolutions

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Treaties, custom and general principles of law
